newsitem.title: USA: Station says management group buys stock.
newsitem.headline: Station says management group buys stock.

text.p: Station Casinos Inc on Wednesday said members of Station management and several directors recently acquired 283,200 shares of company stock, giving the group a 43.4 percent stake in Station.

Some of the people acquiring shares were Frank Fertitta III, chairman and chief executive officer, Lorenzo Fertitta, a director, Blake Sartini, chief operating officer, Delise Sartini, a director, and other members of management.

"The Management Group is taking advantage of the current weakness in our stock," Chief Executive Officer Fertitta said in a statement. "Our purchase demonstrates management's continued confidence in the company."
The shares were purchased from March 31 to April 5, 1997.
